subject: History
source_note: TIE (2023), History Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the relationship between capitalism and Africa

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the development of capitalism and its impact on Africa
competences: Describe the development of capitalism in Europe and its impact on Africa

objectives.text: Describe the development of capitalism in Europe and its impact on Africa
objectives.teaching_methods: Guide students in groups to discuss and role-play the development of capitalism in Europe and its impact on Africa
objectives.resources: Journal articles, reports, speeches and on-line sources on the development of capitalism in Europe and its impact on Africa
objectives.assessment_criteria: The development of capitalism in Europe and its impact on Africa is clearly described

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of colonial systems in Africa
competences: (a) Discuss colonial administrative systems in Africa (German, French, British and Portuguese)
(b) Discuss colonial economic systems in Africa (Establishment, characteristics, sectors, labour issues)
(c) Assess the nature and patterns of colonial social services in Africa
(d) Relate colonial economic, political, infrastructure, and education systems in Africa with the current African systems
